meta.name: CIA Load UI Preview
meta.status: Load UI/UX hotfix - Remove uses existing checked rows
meta.coordinateSystem: DIP-like CSS pixels at 100% browser zoom

designGoals: No application-level vertical scrollbar in normal operation; source list, Details and Settings scroll internally when needed.
Allow the whole desktop shell to shrink substantially in height without reserving large empty minimum areas.
Use an exact two-thirds / one-third split at normal width.
Below the responsive breakpoint, move the entire right rail below the Load area while keeping both regions inside the available viewport height.
When stacked, Item Details and Load Settings remain side-by-side and use their own compact two-column content layouts.
Use compact included/total notation: x / y included.

regions: source list with contextual drag/drop overlay
Discovery state strip under local progress
leftPane.minimumVerticalReservation: none beyond toolbar/summary/progress/drop-strip intrinsic content; source list absorbs remaining height
leftPane.progressPlacement: Bottom of the Load area, below source list and drag/drop strip.
leftPane.discoveryStatePlacement: Dedicated compact strip at the very bottom of the Load area, directly below the workspace-local progress strip.

rightRail.minimumVerticalReservation: none; Details and Settings use internal scrolling

sourceList.summary: Merged into the control row after Refresh selected, using x / y included.

controlRow.responsiveWrap: No Discovery-state content lives in this row.

dragDropOverlay.placement: overlay inside the loaded-source list, anchored near the lower center of the usable list area
dragDropOverlay.text: ⇧ Drag & drop files, folders or archives here
dragDropOverlay.visibilityRule: Show only while there is sufficient empty space below the currently rendered rows. Automatically fade/hide before the last visible loaded-source row reaches the overlay region, so source text never overlaps the drag/drop message. Re-evaluate after filtering, adding sources, scrolling, and window resize.
dragDropOverlay.pointerEvents: none for the visual overlay; the loaded-source list remains the drop target

removeBehavior.control: Existing dusty-red '− Remove' button immediately after Add Archive
removeBehavior.target: rows whose existing checkbox is checked
removeBehavior.effect: remove those checked entries from the current session only; never delete source files from disk
removeBehavior.confirmation: Dynamic compact wording: 'Remove 1 entry?' or 'Remove N entries?'
removeBehavior.discoveryImpact: removal changes the active source set and makes Discovery out of date

rowSelection.purpose: Select one or more loaded-source rows for inspection/details and actions that explicitly use row selection, such as Refresh selected. Remove uses checked/included rows instead.
interaction: Ctrl+Click: add/remove a row from the selection
rowSelection.visual: Selected rows use the existing highlighted-row treatment.

detailsPane.layout: two equal-width metadata columns (50/50), with wide rows only where needed

responsive.behaviorBelowBreakpoint: Use a two-row viewport-contained layout: Load area on top and the entire right rail below. Do not switch to page-level scrolling. The source list, Item Details and Load Settings scroll internally if content exceeds their allocated area.
responsive.stackedHeightAllocation: top Load area 3fr / bottom right rail 2fr
responsive.dragDropBehavior: Overlay follows the source-list viewport and uses the same automatic collision-avoidance rule in both side-by-side and stacked layouts.
